newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes stable, volume dwindles.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes stable, volume dwindles.

text.p: Ghana stock prices ended hardly changed on Friday with trading volume dwindling for the third successive session.
The All-Share Index ended 0.21 points up at 362.33. Volume was 34,710 shares traded, down from 100,510 on Wednesday, with offers more than doubling bids at 497,610 to 210,800.
"Investors are definitely not in a buying mood," one trader said.

Of the two gainers, Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd moved up marginally by 10 cedis to 21,260 cedis while Pioneer Tobacco Co added five cedis to 145 cedis. Aluworks, the only decliner, dipped two cedis to 1,333, its second successive loss.
